observations.detail: Initial state has view zero, Configure, no captures or luminance; capture_views returns while readback is in flight or view is beyond the selected list. Configure moves to Settling; static views collect bounded prime readbacks until latest consecutive finite mean luminances stabilize or budget is exhausted. Warmup and screenshot callbacks require matching current phase and view. Temporal motion intentionally skips settling/convergence and marks lighting ready; exhausted static lighting remains false. The screenshot callback records metrics and returns to Configure after its guarded readback. Separate save outcome and asynchronous same-view generation identity remain open.

Although empty request selects an entire profile, run rebuilds requested_views from all selected non-warmup views. Therefore the shown normal producer includes each pair-required default interior/catalog view in the final requested-view gate. No default-empty-list escape is established for this path; alternative direct state construction remains open. Two None hash values skip a mismatch retry but are recorded nonidentical by is_some_and; no invalid-data pass is inferred.

FNV-1a compresses arbitrary readback bytes into u64, and equality of hashes is recorded under settled_readbacks_identical. Equal 64-bit hashes do not mathematically prove equal byte sequences; the source explicitly treats the hash as nonadversarial, and original Adler already recorded this qualification. The test source checks only its selected changed byte; tests were not run. Actual collision, supported screenshot pair, backend layout and whether bit-exact equality is a required acceptance contract are unproved.

Review requirements audit building plans and compile expected openings. Readiness allows Configure to run, then checks observed resource counts and selected mesh/material assets; it is ordered before capture_views. Its evidence file is written once each ready view index, before the screenshot callback, and is not proof of saved or visually correct output. Earlier independently retained window child readiness, repeated-pending timing and readiness-vs-completion questions remain distinct.

Each P16 archived object equals its per-file a120 base and current95e body, independently also 039 recorded catalog and 6533 per-file bodies; the overall P16 remains dirty. Later tracked patch has recorded SHA fc9002ab1135a438f68eede9217f67d22ef737d2c6938509e6e6660f2fc5b7f7, 159 status entries include seven separately recovered untracked objects, not covered by the tracked patch.
